about: Every Action Cable event the backend broadcasts, and how the frontend handles it. script/check-events fails when the backend, the frontend and this list disagree, so adding or renaming an event means changing all three in one PR. 'explicit': matched by name (event === "...") in frontend/js/message-events.js or notifications.js. 'message': carries a `message` key and is handled by the fall-through at the end of handleIncoming / handleNotification, which re-renders that message.
